title: The Sweetness That Never Runs Out

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Sharing a rare bit of honey, a child wonders whether distant people might have so much sweetness that they eat it every day.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Sharing a rare bit of honey, (name1), a child, wonders whether distant people might have so much sweetness that they eat it every day.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A healer wonders whether that much sweetness would still feel special.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests that distant people might treasure sweet things just as Isolans do.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A farmer wonders whether some distant people might have plenty while others have none.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village shares the honey slowly, and it tastes better for the talk.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child eats all of theirs at once and then wishes they had saved some.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The children imagine mountains of honey and are delighted.
